newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy sells $172.5 of securities.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy sells $172.5 of securities.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said Friday an affiliated trust has successfully sold $172.5 million of 7-3/4 percent convertible quarterly income preferred securities.

The entire issue of 3.45 million CMS Energy Trust preferred securities, which are convertible to shares of CMS common stock at a rate equivalent to a conversion price of $40.80 per share, was purchased by members of the Franklin/Templeton Group of Funds.
Placement was arranged by a group of agents led by Goldman, Sachs & Co., Merrill Lynch & Co., and Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, CMS Energy said.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes including repayment of debt, capital expenditures, investment in subsidiaries and working capital, the company said.
